summary: In international space developments, bad weather has forced China to abruptly postpone the launch of its historic Chang'e-7 mission to the lunar south pole. In commercial spaceflight, SpaceX achieved its 100th Falcon rocket launch of the year, successfully deploying 27 Starlink satellites into orbit. In civil government and planetary science, NASA has funded 18 futuristic spaceflight concepts, including a proposal to send 10,000 tiny "femtosats" to Saturn, while the agency's Curiosity rover discovered a massive field of polygons on Mars upon returning to regular operations. Meanwhile, the James Webb Space Telescope conducted observations of ancient features on Jupiter’s moon Callisto, data from a fleet of 17 spacecraft revealed new findings on solar eruptions, and preliminary research indicated that Earth's magnetosphere may offer less protection against solar superstorms than previously believed. In military developments, virtual foundations courses are being introduced for enlisted airmen as part of a broader reorganization of professional military education. Looking ahead, skywatchers should keep an eye on the skies for an approaching near-total lunar eclipse that will put the Americas in prime viewing position.
